ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: in the figure, the vertical axis is land rent level, and the horizontal axis is distance from the urban central area. The horizontal coordinate is labeled ①②③④⑤⑥ in order from left to right, indicating that the distance from the urban center becomes farther and farther. There are three rent-paying ability curves a, b, and c in the figure, among which the one corresponding to residential land is the curve that is relatively more dominant in the middle distance sections. Then reason: making a vertical comparison by each numbered distance section, residential land has the highest rent-paying ability relative to other land uses in sections ② and ④, indicating that the possibility of residential areas in these two distance sections is relatively large. The question requires selecting the distance section with the greatest possibility of being a residential area that is "relatively close to the city," so between ② and ④ choose ②, which is closer to the urban center.

method.method_draft: 先读图像：横轴表示距城市中心地区距离，数字①—⑥从左到右距离依次增大；图中有工业、商业、住宅三条付租能力曲线。识别住宅用地对应的那条较平缓、在中间距离段占优势的曲线，然后在各数字距离段作纵向比较：住宅曲线在②段和④段相对其他用地付租能力最高。再读题干：要求“距离城市较近、住宅区可能性最大”的距离段，所以在②、④中选更靠近城市中心的②。
